---
title: Add Banner Image
description: >-
  Uploading home screen promotional banners, assigning sequence numbers for
  display priority.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="892" height="493" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Loyalty App > Banner > Add Banner.&#x20;

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="278" height="168" style="width: 278px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Insert banner image. Enter the title and click-through link.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="381" height="258" style="width: 381px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Choose a category for the banner and pick the start and end dates.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="314" height="347" style="width: 314px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="326" height="224" style="width: 326px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
